claim: Time a screen flip so the copy starts with the beam below the window, and sweep raster phases: a good build must pass every phase and a broken one fail where publication reaches display.

evidence.text: The copy ends with the beam in the window's upper rows so a flip there tears; flip at the copy's start with the beam below the window.
Raster phase sweep: 39 valid phases pass and 18 forced unsafe phases are caught; a faster renderer can make a caught negative pass at one phase.
